chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Barqi, from Aban, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
There is no harm in the dung of donkeys, but wash their urine.

key_terms.بِرَوْثِ: regarding the dung; specifically the droppings of an animal
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or problem; indicating permissibility or lack of impurity concern in this context
key_terms.وَاغْسِلْ: and wash; an instruction to cleanse

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on the dung and urine of donkeys in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the excrement of donkeys. It states that donkey dung is not problematic, while their urine must be washed, indicating a distinction in ritual purity rulings.
